recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for core. Do not fold in extension-pack changes here; any artifact-jurisdiction follow-up should remain with FHIR-extensions/FHIR-41866. Topic deprecation from FHIR-38841 was intentionally left untouched.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification request to un-deprecate jurisdiction wherever it had been deprecated in favor of useContext, remove deprecation notes, change definitions to describe the maintaining authority's jurisdiction, add comprehensive examples, and use http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/jurisdiction bindings.
initial_application: Core history contains f48feed3e0 (FHIR-48492 - undeprecate jurisdiction), which removed deprecated status extensions and changed many jurisdiction bindings/search descriptions. Current source still had deprecation notes on active jurisdiction elements, stale Definition/Publishable pattern wording, three active resource definitions still using intended-use wording, and doubled 'the the' search parameter descriptions.
additional_context: FHIR-38841 is the R5 decision that deprecated jurisdiction in favor of useContext; FHIR-48492 reverses that jurisdiction decision because defining jurisdiction is not the same as jurisdictions of use. Zulip and WGM minutes support the reversal. FHIR-41866/extension-pack evidence shows related artifact-jurisdiction extension work belongs outside core and was not edited here.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit that removed remaining jurisdiction deprecation notes from active StructureDefinitions and mapping exceptions, updated Definition and Publishable pattern jurisdiction rows, updated SpecimenDefinition/ObservationDefinition/SubscriptionTopic definitions, preserved THO jurisdiction bindings, and fixed jurisdiction search parameter description typos.
source_changes: Removed stale jurisdiction deprecation guidance from active resource StructureDefinition comments and corresponding definition-pattern exception records.
Updated Definition and Publishable pattern jurisdiction rows from intended-use/deprecated wording to the authority-maintainer jurisdiction wording.
Updated SpecimenDefinition.jurisdiction, ObservationDefinition.jurisdiction, and SubscriptionTopic.jurisdiction definitions to the FHIR-48492 wording.
Corrected jurisdiction search parameter descriptions changed by the historical application so they no longer say 'the the'.
Confirmed jurisdiction bindings use http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/jurisdiction and did not alter unrelated nested product/device jurisdiction elements.

related_jiras.note: Earlier R5 deprecation decision for jurisdiction/topic; FHIR-48492 reverses the jurisdiction part only.
